source.title: Stormforged Helm — Lynlee firsthand disenchant comment
source.author: Lynlee

quote: I disenchanted 28 of these, and got 28 Heavenly Shards.
notes: Firsthand: 28 completed helmet disenchants produced exactly one shard each; commenter explicitly says one per disenchant. No guild perks or other buffs. Historical game build/date/DE skill and original item level unknown; live page scaled ilvl15 does not date the sample.
stats: No guild perks or other buffs, per commenter

source.title: Heavenly Shard — Scott75 original June 2012 Stormforged Legguards study
source.author: Scott75

notes: Original comment states 100 legguards were actually disenchanted and 115 Heavenly Shards obtained in patch 4.3. Author reports guild level-23 Bountiful Bags bonus; excess units may be bonus procs, not extra completed disenchant operations. Exact cast-specific 0/1/2 counts, actual skill, item level and bonuses not given. Do not reuse this study if copied to a crafting/guide page; currency prices omitted.
stats: Guild level 23 Bountiful Bags perk; bonus outputs possible
